title: Polling-based event feed — x402-native alternative to push webhooks. Aggregates
description: Polling-based event feed — x402-native alternative to push webhooks. Aggregates 5 event types: whale_tx (BTC ZMQ stream), regime_change (market regime transitions), funding_extreme (z-score > threshold), price_spike (1h move > threshold), anomaly_fired (ML anomaly alerts). Configurable window (1-1440 min), type filter, coin filter, severity thresholds. Recommended polling cadence: every 1-5 minutes. Cache 60s. Informational research data — not investment advice.
